detail.longDescription: Initially I added Canada to Andrej Karpathy's usaciv ( https://karpathy.ai/usaciv/ ), then found out about 40 other people had done the same for their own countries. So EarthCiv is one world map that links them all. Click a country to open its map. It was built with Claude Code, same as the original.If you built one of the maps and want it added, changed or removed, there's a form in the repo. MIT licensed: https://github.com/earthciv/earthciv
